[Section] Results
[source_id=40] Concerning tag recommendation accuracy, in this section, we report results for different values of INLINEFORM0 (i.e., number of recommended tags). For the beyond-accuracy experiment, we use the full list of recommended tags (i.e., INLINEFORM1 ).
